title: Tomorrow: three meetings, a dentist appointment, and a 4-hour focus block
summary: Draggable time-block metaphor: rearrange the day's tiles with checklists and a block table until the 4-hour focus lands in one unbroken span.

blocks.eyebrow: B render — draggable blocks (metaphor via tables + checklists)
blocks.title: Slide the tiles until focus gets four clean hours
blocks.body: Tomorrow is not a to-do list; it is a set of blocks you can reorder. Meetings and the dentist are mostly fixed. The 4-hour focus block is the piece you drag. Use the checklists like a drag handle: pick a placement, then read the resulting day grid.

blocks.heading: Tile inventory (example times)
blocks.caption: Sticky = treat as nailed down. Drag only the focus tile unless you renegotiate.

blocks.heading: Drag handle — where does the 4-hour focus tile land? (pick one)

items.label: Placement A — early: 07:00–11:00
items.detail: Before standup bleed. Requires starting early; design review still interrupts late morning if it stays at 11:00.

items.label: Placement B — mid: 09:30–13:30
items.detail: Broken by standup + design review unless you shorten or move those. Usually a bad drop zone.

items.label: Placement C — late afternoon/evening: 16:45–20:45
items.detail: After vendor call. Protects morning for errands; energy may dip.

items.label: Placement D — split forbidden: two 2-hour chunks
items.detail: Looks neat on a calendar; fails the '4-hour focus' requirement. Do not drop here.

blocks.heading: Day grid if you drop focus on Placement A (07:00–11:00)
blocks.caption: █ = focus, ▮ = meeting, · = soft buffer. Focus stays contiguous before the 11:00 review.

blocks.heading: Day grid if you drop focus on Placement C (16:45–20:45)
blocks.caption: Focus after the sticky tiles. Works if evenings are quiet and you will not soft-cancel yourself.

blocks.heading: How to 'drag' without a real DnD widget
items: Lock sticky tiles first (standup, design review, dentist).
Find the longest empty span that is actually four hours — not four hours with meetings inside.
Check the matching day grid above (or sketch your own).
If no span exists, renegotiate one sticky tile — do not pretend a split focus block is still four hours.

blocks.title: Recommended drop for this example
blocks.body: Placement A (early focus) or Placement C (evening focus) both keep four unbroken hours. Placement B and any split fail the requirement. Pick the one that matches your energy, then defend it like a meeting with someone important — because it is.

blocks.heading: Before tonight ends
blocks.body: Circle Placement A or C on the checklist. Block it on the real calendar as 'Focus — do not book.' Soft buffers around the dentist travel stay visible.
